messages:
Hannah P.: Heads-up: finance plans to publish an updated invoicing & quota policy effective Nov 15. Highlights: consolidated monthly CSV export, dynamic burst buckets for soft rate-limits, a one-time grace credit applied automatically on the first overage, and trial credits will expire after 90 days going forward. Full rollout doc: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/nov15 :loudspeaker:
Billing Bot: Doc published: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing/nov15 (CSV schema + sample rows + webhook payload)
DevEx: Quick q  what headers will rate-limit responses surface? SDKs need something stable to implement backoff.
Hannah P.: We'll expose `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Mode` (soft|hard), and `X-Redwood-RateLimit-RetryAfter` when applicable. New: `X-Redwood-GraceCredit-Applied: true` for the auto one-time credit.
Eng-Platform: noted. We'll add header parsing + example retry guidance in JS/Python SDKs. ETA for PRs: Nov 5.
Support: How will customers be notified about the one-time grace credit and shortened trial expiry? need canned replies.
RevOps: RevOps to own comms. Drafts in #marketing-drafts; plan: staged emails to paying customers + console banner for trial users. We'll include examples and an FAQ.
Legal: Confirming Dedicated/reserved plans are unchanged?
Hannah P.: Correct. Dedicated and reserved customers keep current guarantees and billing terms. These changes apply to hosted metered plans only.
Customer Success Bot: Action: update KB articles, dispute playbook, and CS canned responses. Schedule training session week of Nov 8.
Hannah P.: Timeline: doc live now, SDK changes by Nov 5, comms ready Nov 8, policy effective Nov 15. AMA scheduled Nov 9 10:00 PT in #all-hands. Please read the doc and drop questions there.
